caption: Alarm Signal Activity
description: Alarm Signal Activity events report signals received from intrusion, environmental, and supervisory detection points. The event type describes what kind of condition was reported; the lifecycle attribute inherited from the base class describes the state transition, mirroring the modifier letter in the SIA DC-03 format and the qualifier field in the Ademco Contact ID protocol. Restore and trouble conditions are therefore not separate activities.
name: alarm_signal_activity

1.caption: Intrusion
1.description: An intrusion detection point was activated. Equivalent to SIA BA and Contact ID 130.

2.caption: Perimeter
2.description: A perimeter detection point was activated. Equivalent to Contact ID 131.

3.caption: Holdup
3.description: A holdup or silent alarm was activated. Equivalent to SIA HA and Contact ID 122.

4.caption: Panic
4.description: A panic alarm was manually activated. Equivalent to SIA PA and Contact ID 120.

5.caption: Tamper
5.description: Detection equipment or its enclosure was tampered with. Equivalent to SIA TA and Contact ID 137.

6.caption: Environmental
6.description: An environmental condition such as water, gas, or temperature was detected.

7.caption: Supervisory
7.description: A supervisory condition such as power or battery was reported. Equivalent to SIA AT or YT and Contact ID 201 or 302.

8.caption: Communication
8.description: A communication path fault was reported. Equivalent to SIA YC and Contact ID 350.

9.caption: Opening
9.description: The zone or partition was disarmed. Equivalent to SIA OP and Contact ID 400.

10.caption: Closing
10.description: The zone or partition was armed. Equivalent to SIA CL and Contact ID 400.

11.caption: Video Analytic
11.description: A video analytic rule was triggered. Equivalent to an ONVIF RuleEngine topic.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The event activity is not mapped. See the activity_name attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
